cohorts.heldout_cohort_comparability: Same first 8 heldout captions, flow timesteps and index-based noise seeds as earlier ordinary diagnostics.
cohorts.train_cohort_limitation: Differs from previous tiny-set diagnostic and full-training seeded fixed 32 probe cohort; do not compare their aggregate train losses as a matched cohort.
cohorts.train_selection_policy: Source full-stage train_selection is the full ordered pool; use its first 8 indices 0..7.
cohorts.validation_selection_policy: Indices 0..7; wrong captions drawn from the 100-example heldout split.
cohorts.wrong_training_captions: Selected from the full source training pool, not only the 8 diagnostic targets.

images.image_guidance_limitation: Ordinary diagnostic fixes image guidance to 1; full training used 2. No source image is supplied in these caption-to-image routes, so that knob is inactive. This preserves the actual earlier ordinary diagnostic behavior.
images.ordinary_gallery_references: Renderer uses adapted-native references; original-native images are separately saved.
images.prism_negative_anchor: Untrained ablation; not a trained unconditional context.

limitations: These are 16 captions and 2 image cases, not a comprehensive benchmark.
Ordinary diagnostic records actual flow noise/timestep hashes, image hashes and initial sampling latents; do not claim the stronger factorial CFG-branch/final-latent trace audit.
Low denoising loss alone does not establish requested-object fidelity.
purpose: Evaluate the completed full-data learning experiment; this does not introduce a new training gate.

They are absent for this ordinary diagnostic, as in the actual prior diagnostic. The unchanged launcher does not promise a CPU32 cap or binding. Do not claim one without an explicitly reviewed runtime wrapper or launcher change.
